[04/10/2026, 17:00] Mama Kevo: Habari, mnauza K-Gas 13kg full na cylinder?
[04/10/2026, 17:05] Salim: Ndio mama. Ni 7,000 kila moja
[04/10/2026, 17:06] Mama Kevo: Nataka mbili. Mbili zote ni 14,000? Punguza kidogo
[04/10/2026, 17:09] Salim: Sawa, mbili nitakupea 13,000 jumla
[04/10/2026, 17:10] Mama Kevo: Poa, 13,000 sawa. Ziwe na regulator?
[04/10/2026, 17:12] Salim: Hapana, regulator haiko. Ni cylinder na gas tu, zimejaa
[04/10/2026, 17:13] Mama Kevo: Ok sawa. Mtaleta na boda?
[04/10/2026, 17:15] Salim: Ndio, boda italeta kesho asubuhi
[04/10/2026, 17:15] Mama Kevo: Asante
notes: Relative date: mixed Swahili, quantity 2 negotiated from 14,000 to 13,000 total; 'kesho' on Sun 4 Oct = 2026-10-05.
